caption: A pair of sunglasses lies on a table facing a lamp, and the lamp shows as two small images in the lenses.

sa.check: A pair of sunglasses lies on a table facing a lamp.
The lamp shows as images in the lenses.
There are two images, one in each lens.

pc.expect: The images show the lamp and would move if the lamp or glasses moved.
pc.fail: They show something behind the glasses; or they are missing with the lamp on; or they show a different lamp.

pc.expect: There are two images, one per lens, each curved to its lens.
pc.fail: There is one image or three; or they are flat; or they are larger than the lenses.

pc.expect: The images do not move with the lamp and glasses still.
pc.fail: They drift across the lenses; or flicker with a steady lamp.
They ripple; or bend; or go opaque.

pc.expect: One pair of glasses and one lamp.
pc.fail: The glasses duplicate; or the lamp vanishes; or an image becomes solid.

pc.expect: The glasses, the lamp and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The frames change colour; or the lamp changes; or the table changes.
